C1_mass_C_a16.note: nH - NMR total must equal 6: the 4 phenol OH and 2 amide NH are not integrated in the printed list, which is itself a structural statement (four phenols, and the diketopiperazine NH unsubstituted)

C2_hit_rule_reconstruction.rule: the paper defines a hit as luminescence > 5x DLin-MC3-DMA
C2_hit_rule_reconstruction.scope: PHENOL LIBRARY ONLY (Fig. 1e). The paper states the rule inside its phenol-library paragraph and reports hits per phenol tail, so the reconstruction is scoped the same way. Applied to all 310 lipids the same threshold also catches G-a12 (thiol, log10 = 6.074), which clears it yet was not taken into mice - so no single threshold over the whole library reproduces exactly the 11.
C2_hit_rule_reconstruction.discrepancy: the Results text prints 0, 3, 6 and 2 hits for phenols A-D; the Source Data give 0, 2, 6 and 3, and the paper's OWN in-vivo panel (Fig. 1k-p) carries 2 B-lipids and 3 D-lipids, so the printed B and D counts are transposed. Which 11 lipids are hits is not in doubt: one threshold reproduces all 11 exactly.
